topic: Updating facility data for JCDecaux UK
summary_markdown: Someone requested that three specific redacted items be added to the 'Target facility' on the conversion table for the client JCDecaux UK, and simultaneously removed from the 'Source Facilities'. [me] confirmed completing the first part of the request but noted a limitation: there is currently no feature to 'show all except some'. To proceed quickly, [me] plans to input all facilities into the source list *except* for the three specified ones.
decisions: Three specific items will be added to the Target facility on the conversion table for JCDecaux UK.
These three items must be removed from the Source Facilities.
action_items: [me] needs to figure out a workaround for excluding facilities from the source list, possibly by listing all except the three specified ones.
